responsibility: Implements attribute-driven debugging dumps for the collect phase by traversing crate items and emitting diagnostics that print computed opaque hidden types, instantiated predicates, item bounds, and DefId parent chains, including anonymous const parents discovered inside body owners.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `outlives/dump.rs` and `variance/dump.rs`, this dump file is for collect-phase introspection: it walks crate items and bodies to print predicates, item bounds, opaque hidden types, and def-parent chains, not the results of a single inference framework.
